context_stem: To make the required showing, we will need to satisfy the following criteria:
excerpt: Threat modeling: Follow risk governance best practices, such as use of the MITRE ATT&CK Framework to establish the relationship between the identified threats, sensitive assets, attack vectors and, in doing so, sufficiently capture the resulting risks that must be addressed to protect model weights from theft attempts.
paraphrase: Anthropic must follow risk governance practices like the MITRE ATT&CK Framework to map threats, assets, and vectors relevant to weight theft.

context_stem: Threat modeling: Follow risk governance best practices...
excerpt: As part of this requirement, we should specify our plans for revising the resulting threat model over time.
paraphrase: Anthropic should specify plans to revise the threat model over time.

context_stem: To make the required showing, we will need to satisfy the following criteria:
excerpt: Security frameworks: Align to and, as needed, extend industry-standard security frameworks for addressing identified risks, such as disclosure of sensitive information, tampering with accounts and assets, and unauthorized elevation of privileges with the appropriate controls. This includes:
paraphrase: Anthropic must align with and extend industry-standard security frameworks to address risks like data disclosure, tampering, and privilege escalation.

context_stem: Security frameworks: Align to and, as needed, extend industry-standard security frameworks... This includes:
excerpt: Perimeters and access controls: Building strong perimeters and access controls around sensitive assets to ensure AI models and critical systems are protected from unauthorized access.
paraphrase: Sub-item on building strong perimeters and access controls to protect AI models and critical systems from unauthorized access.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: The full set of security measures that we commit to (and have already started implementing) are described in this appendix, and were developed in consultation with the authors of a forthcoming RAND report on securing AI weights.

context_stem: Perimeters and access controls: Building strong perimeters and access controls around sensitive assets...
excerpt: We expect this will include a combination of physical security, encryption, cloud security, infrastructure policy, access management, and weight access minimization and monitoring.
paraphrase: Expected components include physical security, encryption, cloud security, infrastructure policy, access management, and weight access minimization/monitoring.

context_stem: Security frameworks: Align to and, as needed, extend industry-standard security frameworks... This includes:
excerpt: Lifecycle security: Securing links in the chain of systems and software used to develop models, to prevent compromised components from being introduced and to ensure only trusted code and hardware is used.
paraphrase: Sub-item on securing the development supply chain to prevent compromised components and ensure trusted code/hardware use.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Internal compartmentalization: We will limit access to training techniques and model hyperparameters to a need-to-know basis, in order to avoid proliferation of dangerous AI models and the empowerment of bad actors.

context_stem: Lifecycle security: Securing links in the chain of systems and software used to develop models...
excerpt: We expect this will include a combination of software inventory, supply chain security, artifact integrity, binary authorization, hardware procurement, and secure research development lifecycle.
paraphrase: Expected components include software inventory, supply chain security, artifact integrity, binary authorization, hardware procurement, and secure R&D lifecycle.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Internal compartmentalization: We will limit access to training techniques and model hyperparameters to a need-to-know basis, in order to avoid proliferation of dangerous AI models and the empowerment of bad actors.

excerpt: We will implement robust insider risk controls to mitigate most insider risk, but consider mitigating risks from highly sophisticated state-compromised insiders to be out of scope for ASL-3.
paraphrase: Robust insider risk controls will address most insider threats, but highly sophisticated state-compromised insiders are out of scope for ASL-3.

excerpt: We are committed to further enhancing these protections as a part of our ASL-4 preparations.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to enhancing insider protections further as part of ASL-4 preparations.

context_stem: Security frameworks: Align to and, as needed, extend industry-standard security frameworks... This includes:
excerpt: Monitoring: Proactively identifying and mitigating threats through ongoing and effective monitoring, testing for vulnerabilities, and laying traps for potential attackers.
paraphrase: Sub-item on proactive threat identification via monitoring, vulnerability testing, and attacker traps.

context_stem: Monitoring: Proactively identifying and mitigating threats through ongoing and effective monitoring...
excerpt: We expect this will include a combination of endpoint patching, product security testing, log management, asset monitoring, and intruder deception techniques.
paraphrase: Expected components include endpoint patching, product security testing, log management, asset monitoring, and deception techniques.

context_stem: Security frameworks: Align to and, as needed, extend industry-standard security frameworks... This includes:
excerpt: Resourcing: Investing sufficient resources in security.
paraphrase: Sub-item requiring sufficient investment of resources in security.

context_stem: Resourcing: Investing sufficient resources in security.
excerpt: We expect meeting this standard of security to require roughly 5-10% of employees being dedicated to security and security-adjacent work.
paraphrase: Meeting the security standard is expected to require about 5-10% of employees dedicated to security-related work.

context_stem: Security frameworks: Align to and, as needed, extend industry-standard security frameworks... This includes:
excerpt: Existing guidance: Aligning where appropriate with existing guidance on securing model weights, including Securing AI Model Weights, Preventing Theft and Misuse of Frontier Models (2024); security recommendations like Deploying AI Systems Securely (CISA/NSA/FBI/ASD/CCCS/GCSB /GCHQ), ISO 42001, CSA's AI Safety Initiative, and CoSAI; and standards frameworks like SSDF, SOC 2, NIST 800-53.
paraphrase: Anthropic will align with existing external guidance and standards on securing model weights, including named frameworks and agency recommendations.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: The full set of security measures that we commit to (and have already started implementing) are described in this appendix, and were developed in consultation with the authors of a forthcoming RAND report on securing AI weights.

context_stem: To make the required showing, we will need to satisfy the following criteria:
excerpt: Audits: Develop plans to (1) audit and assess the design and implementation of the security program and (2) share these findings (and updates on any remediation efforts) with management on an appropriate cadence.
paraphrase: Anthropic must develop plans to audit the security program and share findings with management regularly.
